issues.problem: None blocking. All 288 combinations checked: every thing value takes 開ける with を, every request ending attaches to the te-form and fits each addressee, English articles and request phrasing are right. Distractors 開いて (intransitive with を), 開けられて (cannot take a request ending) and 閉まって (wrong verb, intransitive) are plainly wrong everywhere. このびん is glossed 'this jar' (びん is also 'bottle'); both are correct.

None blocking. All 384 combinations checked: every event value is a natural が-subject of 始まる with a から start time, and every day value reads well with は and the English sentence opener. Distractors 始めます / 始めています (transitive with が) and 終えます (transitive, opposite meaning) are wrong for every combination. 始められます is correctly left out because the passive would be grammatical.

None blocking. All 384 combinations checked: each 'container に object' value takes 入れる with を, and the English 'put X in Y' is correct for each value. 入りました and 入られました are ungrammatical with を. 入れられました is a grammatical potential ('was able to put'), but it changes the meaning so the English no longer fits, which matches the tr- area rule (passive or potential distractors).

Each pack drills only one member of its skill's set (開ける, 始まる, 入れる), because a pack has a fixed answer and a fixed d. The other members (閉める, つける, 消す, 終わる, 止める, 続く, 出す, 上げる ...) have to be rotated in through items or further packs.
